Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
cool ideas, but bad text.

Let's try something like this :

Ashes of the Eldest
type: Unique Equipment
Cost: 2 pool

When a Vampire successfully equips with Ashes of the Eldest, choose two disciplines that this vampire does not have. This Vampire gains inferior level of those disciplines. He is one generation older. Any Vampire controlled by another Methuselah can steal this equipment as a D action.

Swordmaster
Type : master
Cost : 1 pool

Put this card on a ready Vampire. A Vampire with this card inflicts an additional damage when striking with a melle weapon. A Vampire can have only one Swordmaster.

Gunner

Type : master
Cost : 1 pool

Put this card on a ready Vampire. A Vampire with this card inflicts an additional damage when striking with a Gun. A Vampire can have only one Gunner.

Better? B)

Messages.Author: Lech
Messages.Body:
It don't need to be archetype, and it make no thematic sense for those to be archetypes. Archetypes are all about regaining willpower represented as blood or doing stuff with willpower (say untap for 1 blood) for doing things in line with the vampire character. Not with boosting combat prowess.

Sabbat.Black Hand Shakar: Lech loathe ranged weapons. Once each action, he may burn 1 blood to become Camarilla Prince of Krakow until the end of the action.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Yeah, but the point is to avoid having a Marksman Curmudgeon/Creepshow or say a Master At Arms-Sociopath. I don't mind the idea of having 4 or 5 vampires with say Marksman or Master-at-Arms... but I don't think there should be a combination of them and the existing Archetypes.

The only card that gives an unconditional +damage in combat is Depravity. Its +strength, its unique and it costs 1 pool. So it seems to balance out to make it remove other archetypes (can't get bonus damage to melee and range).

I could potentially see them being Trifles, but it may make them too powerful.

The Elder's Ashes seems to be fairly strong, but I do think it should potentially involve a "combat theft" option...

"A minion may enter combat with the minion with this equipment. During that combat, the minion which deals the most damage by the end of that combat move this equipment to that minion." Instead of just a  action steal action.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: miketheknife
Messages.Body:
I loved the sword master - gunner idea (with juggernaut's names and pendargon's text).

IMHO, the idea seems balanced, since they do not give "unconditional" damage (you have to strike with a gun or melee weapon). Master at Arms may seem a little underpowered in comparisson to Depravity, but the diference comes to the uniqueness, since there may be only one depravity in game and many MaA.

At a glimpse, the 1 pool cost may seem to low for a +1 damage, but it has to be considered that the extra damage requires an extra card (the weapon) to work.
